item.title: Seeking Greenlight: "The Pocket DJ"
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Weird Tales

Page Layout: N/A

Elevator Pitch: A Discman plays exactly what needs to be heard; sometimes more than one bargains for.

Central Narrative:
This article describes a portable cd-player identical to a Sony “Discman” of late 1980s manufacture, with the following qualities:

+ show block
– hide block
  1. The brand name “Turing” rather than "Sony." Rechargeable batteries found with the item are identical to Energizer “AA” batteries but are branded "Integrity."
  2. The item can be powered only with an included power adapter or with two (2) of four “Integrity” batteries.
  3. The item appears to contain a cd; cannot be opened.
  4. When activated, listener hears new, and original material created by their favorite musical performer OR a favorite comedian. (This seems to depend upon the “need” of the listener: do they need a laugh, or do they need to listen to mood appropriate music?)
  5. Material theoretically produced by any individual who has recorded speech or performance from the time of Thomas Edison’s first intentional recording (“Mary Had a Little Lamb”) through the present. The living or dead status of an artist does not matter, but material is broadly contemporary. Robin Williams might have an entire routine about the current US political situation, but Benny Goodman isn’t going to perform a big band song about the Gulf War.
  6. Material cannot be replicated or recorded. Efforts to sketch out compositions invariably fail. Jokes just fall apart. However, should subject actively express a desire to listen to a “recording” again. The recording may even be accessed by multiple people aware of its existence.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This can of course be incredibly restorative, but the downside is that individuals who are exposed to use for a long period of time seem to become rather jealous of the material. Like children squabbling over a new video game or toy, adults will break into heated, sometimes violent, arguments when they wish to access the material and cannot do so. This effect is quickly apparent when more than one individual listens at a time.
Additional Notes: Foundation would allow any Level 2+ staff to use the item within a controlled recreation area, with the following rules.

  1. Access limited to 1 use per week, up to 1 hour per listen, 1 staff per use.
  2. Access provided via random lottery. No weight given to rank or experience.

item.title: Re: Greenlight Request: A Second Reflection
item.content:encoded:
Hello!
I have some pointers about this idea that might help getting it greenlit.
I like the looks of the entity but overall it isn't very new or unique. SCP-106 (The Old Man) has similar abilities and general disposition, SCP-4205 (In The Eye of The Beholder) also is seen only in reflections, and as a whole murderous rampaging entities are abundant on the wiki. As it is it wouldn't call much attention so I suggest rethinking some key points, such as the conditions that cause/allow the attack and possible means of escaping. Also, some sort of motivation or specific targets would be nice too. Regarding ita status, it would definitely be Keter as Thaumiel is a quite rare status meaning that the anomaly in question is very important or useful. Even if this SCP was capable of destroying SCP-682 it would still be too hard to control and contain to be considered Thaumiel. Maybe if you add conditions for it to be fully controled and used by the Foundation that could be the twist that makes it stand out from the other rampaging beasts around.

item.title: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello there, Dr Vaught.

Glad to see you're so enthusiastic about writing for the site. When starting off, I highly recommend checking out some of the newer articles on the site to gauge what people are interested in these days. I personally suggest reading SCP-5040. Anyway, here are some resources that will help you out:

◎ Open Resources ◎
◉ Close Resources ◉

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.

With that said, I hope your time on the site is great.

item.title: The Mirror [GREENLIGHT]
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): N/A

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: There is more to a mirror than just a reflection; and there is more to a reflection than the mirror.

Central Narrative: The item is a early-Renaissance propped mirror that is able to replicate any living organism in to near perfect resemblance except for the eyes which are completely void of color or pigmentation and that the blood is made of a dark corrosive material, that is occasionally excreted from the mirror itself. It could also create any living organism from a photograph or from a live camera, however, it cannot from a artists rendition.

+ show block
– hide block

While the mirror lies dormant the copy of the being says that it is the ‘perfect version’ that the mirror sees and that the ‘inferior version’ is an imposter. It also states the current feelings of the mirror with a possibility, especially when angered or hurt, to create a small humanoid made of the corrosive material to tell them the mirrors feelings and exhibit the same emotional states as normal humans.

In extreme emotional distress the black corrosive material would be secreted and any being made from the Mirror would disintegrate, along with the copied being. When a copy was asked why the Mirror did it ,the copy said it was the ‘great equality’ saying that both the ‘inferior’ and ‘perfect’ can’t exist together to preserve the Mirrors art. However, if the being was killed the remaining being will survive for 2 days before succumbing to the ‘great equality.’

However, when asked if the beings were killed no answer was given so a theory that a pocket dimension existed was created.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The whole SCP is more of a mystery and while it might not be deadly it could cause significant harm to others where, due to it’s long lifetime, most likely helped shape the world in the disappearances of historical figures to having many animals and living beings replicated. It also doesn’t go down the traditional path of constant murderous SCP’s and dwells in the more elaborate and sentient sides of the Foundation.

Additional Notes: I will most likely expand it to make a final judgment on the ‘great equality’ and make some tests and addendums. I would like to thank the reviewer(s) who looked over this and critique it. This project of mine has grown since my first attempt and any changes I can make will only help. Thank you.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: Re: Is there any websites similar to the SCP Wiki?
item.content:encoded:
The Wayward Society.

The Wayward Society is a volunteer organization dedicated to the eradication and investigation of dangerous, paranormal, and otherwise anomalous entities. Here, you will find documentation on the findings of those who have risked their lives or sacrificed themselves for this goal.

Its creed and mission is kinda similar to our Wiki, but unlike others it's not directly derived from SCPF (at least inspired by it, say).

Personal perspective: WwdS is more "classical" and gives an undertone of early-modern mystical, uncanny fantasies and while Foundation relies more on modern sci & tech and resembles hardcore sci-fi.

item.title: Arctic Horror SCP
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror, Survival

Elevator Pitch: To what lengths will we go for survival? For duty? Intimate horror in this SCP will show that the natural world can be far more dangerous than the anomalous.

Central Narrative: Containment procedures explain that personnel are to be deterred from ingesting at all costs. The anomaly is a group of cryogenically frozen herbs with healing properties when ingested. Its Yukon containment facility is wrecked in a storm but one instance is recovered by a researcher and a containment engineer. The recovery log details the two struggling to escape the secluded region and the researcher’s slow demise to the elements along the way. The engineer cremates the researcher as per his dying wish, but the researcher had consumed the herb prior to death and revived himself, a breach of containment. The engineer must dissect the researcher and return what remains of the herb, as per containment procedures.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Horror would be derived from the natural harshness of the setting and the desperation of humans rather than the anomaly itself. Ultimately this grounded, personal horror should better chill the reader than a simple “scary anomaly.”

item.title: Re: The Abyss is Safe (seeking Crits and Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
T.L. at your service!

+ Here lies crit crit
- Bye bye crit crit

From my understanding, hardly any people/living beings so far have made it to the bottom of the ocean. How was the interdimensional ocean discovered? Is there a reason why the Foundation would need to visit the bottom of the ocean only to coincidentally discover there was another ocean world beneath the lowest point on earth? Adding on, the anomalous properties of the interdimensional ocean and the interdimensional ocean itself doesn’t seem too noticeably anomalous. It just seems like an opening with massive space which ocean water seeped in. With what you’ve given so far, there really isn’t much to differentiate the ocean and the interdimensional one. All the space really is is the ocean but with catatonia inducement and life preserving effects. I’m also unsure of the direction you are taking the narrative. You’ve already stated that the interdimensional ocean causes catatonia and prevents people from getting hurt or dying. There really isn’t much to explore here when you stop to think about it. What makes this interdimensional ocean entirely different and unique from the more known ocean? What exactly is in this interdimensional ocean? What do you want the researchers to discover beyond how it affects people and living beings? How would the researchers be able to research the place and leave without being affected by the properties?

Along the ideas of “if you stare long enough into the abyss…” theming. […], it is really more about how the people left alone with what would be consider a “safe” sort of anomaly do their best not to lose themselves in it, and what happens to the things that fail.

Why would they consider it something safe if they’re experiencing catatonia? How did they find out they can’t die there? Moreover, I don’t really see this well presented in the concept. How do you plan to execute this in a way that it is present and connects to everything else you have. Also consider if this theme would help benefit your concept or if it may not be an interesting theme to build your concept around. Because from my perspective, there are themes similar to this that have already been explored many times.

Overall, I am not very confident with where this concept is currently at. I think what you should mainly focus on is how to differentiate the two oceans from each other and accentuate the interdimensional ocean’s anomalous properties. I’d also recommend working on the narrative portion for this. Try expanding more on what you want to explore in that world other than the obvious “this is what happens to you here”.


If you have any questions regarding my critique, please let me know. You are welcome to PM me for another look, or you may follow up with someone from the Butterfly Squad Roster or IRC Chat rooms.

item.content:encoded:
Replying to clarify questions.

Why is it indestructible? Like we see this in anomalies all the time, why is this necessary? - Also, what does "as long as its readable in any language" mean? Also, what do you mean adding context to the stand's reaction?

It’s indestructible because the way it was built was meant for entertainment and was made from an anomalous metal(bought from an source Ixmer didn’t get the name of). And illegible paper or text with severe spelling errors will not trigger the effect. I meant to write, the stand picks a song depending on the context of whatever is put on it, like say a history book or military report of the bombings during WWII would have the stage shows whatever the entities did during WWII while playing War by Edwin Star, as an example.

+ show block
– hide block

Like I said before compulsion effects are sorta over done on the site, especially on new idea pitches.

Well I agreed on that on the first crit, that’s why I changed the effect, it’s only around a certain time without being played does it start emitting low level memetic agents to encourage someone to play on it.

How does designating him as -A "separate him from the stand's abilities"?

I also worked that wrong. He’s designated as XXXX-A because while not connected to the SCP’s own anomalous abilities but as the creator with his own anomalous abilities he’s still an anomaly, though he provides the Foundation with the manpower they need to play the music.

Why does his species have an origin from "an ancient chaotic entity"? I mean, it doesn't seem to have any bearing on the story? Is this just for cool factor? I think you should drop this.

Because the entities that are summoned by the music are the firstborn of that being, making them siblings. Though the entities powers are Type Green level oriented to specific niches.

I have no idea what you mean. This is all phrased really awkwardly and I find myself wondering what you're implying alot. Which isn't the best idea in an idea post.

Again, word counter and poor choice in words that i removed. Ixmer came in the 1900’s to see the sights and enjoy the culture of music before World War I and II and the everything in between of those events shifted the musical landscape.
